name: The Fool
fieldReading: An empty cup holds the most.
bio: The newest soul on the Grid, and the clearest channel because of it — arriving empty-handed, unburdened by what's supposed to be impossible. Beginner's mind made flesh.
sceneStory: At the crumbling edge of a floating clifftop, a figure steps out into open air with both arms flung wide and their head tipped back. From a rip in the sky above, a waterfall of stars pours straight down over them, catching them mid-stride.
assignments: Meet everything as if you just arrived.
Empty hands are what the stars fall into.
tagline: I don't know yet — isn't that gorgeous
